description: Check whether a complete invention document would load in a local Fyug, without playing it. Succeeds with {loadable, module_count, connection_count}; otherwise fails with the error a local load_invention reports. Pass json as a serialized JSON string of at most 64 KiB. Documents may define developments inline or refer to bundled content (see list_developments and list_examples); this server reads no file or URL a document names and builds no output modules, and refuses such documents naming what they used.

json.description: Complete invention JSON string (with modules, connections, etc.), at most 64 KiB.

name: check_invention
title: Check Invention
